anvil:aws:CognitoUserPool.description: An Anvil-managed Cognito user pool. Tier 1 controls (deletion protection, enforced password policy, account recovery via email) are always on. Pair with CognitoAuth to protect API Gateway routes.

appClient.description: Default app client created with the user pool. Covers the 80% case of one application per pool. Use hatch for additional clients.

attributes.description: User attribute configuration. Controls sign-in identifiers and required attributes on sign-up.

emailConfiguration.description: Email delivery configuration. Default: Cognito-managed email (5 emails/day limit). Set sesFromAddress for SES delivery in production.

hostedUi.description: Hosted UI / Managed Login configuration. Omit to use the Cognito user pools API directly without a hosted sign-in page.

identityProviders.description: External identity providers to federate with this user pool. Supports Google, Facebook, LoginWithAmazon, SignInWithApple, OIDC, and SAML. Schema never changes per provider — add new providers by extending this array.

mfa.description: MFA configuration. TOTP requires no additional AWS resources. SMS requires an SNS caller ARN.

passwordPolicy.description: Password policy for the user pool. Anvil enforces a secure baseline by default — override only to strengthen.

waf.description: Attaches a regional WAF WebACL to the user pool. AWS recommends a WAF for every public user pool — it protects sign-in and sign-up against credential stuffing, brute force, bots and SMS pumping. Use an Anvil Waf created with scope "regional" in the same region as the pool.

appClientId.description: The ID of the default app client. Pass to CognitoAuth audience.

appClientSecret.description: The client secret of the default app client. Only populated when appClient.generateSecret is true. Treat as sensitive.

cloudFrontDomain.description: The CloudFront distribution domain for the custom hosted UI. Only populated when hostedUi.customDomain is true. Create a Route53 alias record pointing hostedUi.domain to this value to complete DNS setup. Empty string for Cognito-managed domains.

endpoint.description: The Cognito OIDC issuer URL. Format: https://cognito-idp.{region}.amazonaws.com/{userPoolId}. Pass directly to CognitoAuth if building the authorizer manually.

hostedUiDomain.description: The full hosted UI domain (e.g. https://auth.myapp.com or https://myprefix.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com). Empty string if hostedUi is not configured.

userPoolArn.description: The ARN of the Cognito user pool.

userPoolId.description: The Cognito user pool ID. Pass to CognitoAuth.userPoolId.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolAppClient.description: Default app client configuration. Covers the 80% case — one client per pool.

callbackUrls.description: Allowed redirect URLs after successful sign-in. Required when using the hosted UI.

generateSecret.description: Generate a client secret. Required for confidential clients (server-side apps). Must NOT be set for SPAs — never expose secrets in browser code. Default: false.

oauthFlows.description: Allowed OAuth flows. Default: [code]. Use code (PKCE) for SPAs and server apps. client_credentials for M2M.

oauthScopes.description: OAuth scopes to allow. Default: [openid, email, profile].

supportedIdentityProviders.description: Identity providers shown on the hosted UI login page for this client. Default: [COGNITO]. Add provider names from identityProviders here to show social login buttons.

tokenValidity.description: Token validity periods. Anvil defaults: access 1h, id 1h, refresh 30d.

customAttributes.description: Custom attributes to add to user profiles. Cannot be deleted after pool creation.

requiredAttributes.description: Standard attributes required on sign-up. Default: [email]. Cannot be changed after pool creation.

usernameAttributes.description: Attributes users can sign in with. Default: [email]. Set to [phone_number] or [email, phone_number] to allow both. Cannot be changed after pool creation.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolClientOverrides.description: Low-level overrides passed directly to the underlying aws.cognito.UserPoolClient resource.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolCustomAttribute.description: A custom attribute to add to user profiles.

mutable.description: Whether the attribute can be changed after a user is created. Default: true.

name.description: Attribute name. Cognito prefixes this with 'custom:' automatically.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolDomainOverrides.description: Low-level overrides passed directly to the underlying aws.cognito.UserPoolDomain resource.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolEmailConfigurat.description: Email delivery configuration. Default uses Cognito-managed email which has a 50 emails/day limit. Configure SES for production workloads.

replyToAddress.description: Reply-to address shown in outgoing emails. Optional.

sesFromAddress.description: Verified SES sender address (e.g. noreply@myapp.com). Setting this switches delivery to SES, removing the 50 emails/day limit. The address must be verified in SES in the same region as the user pool.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolHostedUi.description: Hosted UI (Managed Login) configuration. Enables the Cognito-hosted sign-in page.

acmCertificateArn.description: ACM certificate ARN for the custom domain. Must be in us-east-1 regardless of user pool region — this is a hard AWS requirement. Required when customDomain is true.

customDomain.description: Set to true when domain is a custom FQDN you own. Requires acmCertificateArn. Anvil creates the CloudFront distribution and wires the alias automatically. Default: false.

domain.description: Domain for the hosted UI. For Cognito-managed domains, provide just the prefix (e.g. 'myapp' → myapp.auth.{region}.amazoncognito.com). For custom domains, provide the fully-qualified domain name (e.g. 'auth.myapp.com'). Required.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolIdentityProvide.description: An external identity provider to federate with this user pool. Discriminated by type — the same schema covers all provider types. Add new providers by extending the identityProviders array, no schema changes required.

attributeMapping.description: Maps Cognito user attributes to provider-specific claim names. Key is the Cognito attribute (e.g. 'email'), value is the provider claim (e.g. 'email' for Google, or the full SAML attribute URI for SAML providers).

clientId.description: OAuth client ID from the identity provider. Required for Google, Facebook, LoginWithAmazon, SignInWithApple, OIDC.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret from the identity provider. Required for Google, Facebook, LoginWithAmazon, OIDC. Not used for SAML.

metadataContent.description: Inline SAML metadata XML. Required for SAML when metadataUrl is not provided.

metadataUrl.description: URL of the SAML metadata document. Required for SAML when metadataContent is not provided.

name.description: Friendly name for this provider. Required for OIDC and SAML providers. Optional for well-known social providers (Google, Facebook etc.) — defaults to the type name.

oidcIssuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. Required when type is OIDC. Cognito fetches the discovery document from {oidcIssuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration.

type.description: Provider type. Determines which fields are required. Google/Facebook/LoginWithAmazon/SignInWithApple require clientId and clientSecret. OIDC additionally requires oidcIssuer. SAML requires metadataUrl or metadataContent.

enum.description: Google OAuth 2.0. Requires clientId and clientSecret.
Facebook OAuth 2.0. Requires clientId and clientSecret.
Login with Amazon. Requires clientId and clientSecret.
Sign in with Apple. Requires clientId and clientSecret.
Generic OIDC provider (Okta, Auth0, Microsoft Entra, etc.). Requires clientId, clientSecret, and oidcIssuer.
SAML 2.0 provider (corporate SSO, Active Directory Federation Services etc.). Requires metadataUrl or metadataContent.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolMfa.description: MFA configuration for the user pool.

methods.description: MFA methods to enable. TOTP requires no additional AWS resources. SMS requires snsCallerArn.

snsCallerArn.description: ARN of the IAM role Cognito uses to send SMS messages via SNS. Required when methods includes SMS. Anvil will create this role automatically if omitted and SMS is enabled.

enum.description: Time-based one-time password (authenticator app). No additional AWS resources required.
SMS one-time password via SNS. Requires snsCallerArn.
MFA available but not required. Users opt in.
Authorization code grant (PKCE). Most secure — use for all browser and server apps.
Implicit grant. Deprecated — tokens visible in browser URL. Avoid for new applications.
Client credentials grant. M2M only — no user interaction.

accountRecoverySetting.description: Configuration block to define which verified available method a user can use to recover their forgotten password. Detailed below.

adminCreateUserConfig.description: Configuration block for creating a new user profile. Detailed below.

aliasAttributes.description: Attributes supported as an alias for this user pool. Valid values: `phone_number`, `email`, or `preferred_username`. Conflicts with `username_attributes`.

autoVerifiedAttributes.description: Attributes to be auto-verified. Valid values: `email`, `phone_number`.

deletionProtection.description: When active, DeletionProtection prevents accidental deletion of your user pool. Before you can delete a user pool that you have protected against deletion, you must deactivate this feature. Valid values are `ACTIVE` and `INACTIVE`, Default value is `INACTIVE`.

deviceConfiguration.description: Configuration block for the user pool's device tracking. Detailed below.

emailConfiguration.description: Configuration block for configuring email. Detailed below.

emailMfaConfiguration.description: Configuration block for configuring email Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA); requires at least 2 `account_recovery_setting` entries; requires an `email_configuration` configuration block. Effective only when `mfa_configuration` is `ON` or `OPTIONAL`. Detailed below.

emailVerificationMessage.description: String representing the email verification message. Conflicts with `verification_message_template` configuration block `email_message` argument.

emailVerificationSubject.description: String representing the email verification subject. Conflicts with `verification_message_template` configuration block `email_subject` argument.

lambdaConfig.description: Configuration block for the AWS Lambda triggers associated with the user pool. Detailed below.

mfaConfiguration.description: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) configuration for the User Pool. Defaults of `OFF`. Valid values are `OFF` (MFA Tokens are not required), `ON` (MFA is required for all users to sign in; requires at least one of `email_mfa_configuration`, `sms_configuration` or `software_token_mfa_configuration` to be configured), or `OPTIONAL` (MFA Will be required only for individual users who have MFA Enabled; requires at least one of `email_mfa_configuration`, `sms_configuration` or `software_token_mfa_configuration` to be configured).

passwordPolicy.description: Configuration block for information about the user pool password policy. Detailed below.

region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration.

schemas.description: Configuration block for the schema attributes of a user pool. Detailed below. Schema attributes from the [standard attribute set](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/user-pool-settings-attributes.html#cognito-user-pools-standard-attributes) only need to be specified if they are different from the default configuration. Attributes can be added, but not modified or removed. Maximum of 50 attributes.

signInPolicy.description: Configuration block for information about the user pool sign in policy. Detailed below.

smsAuthenticationMessage.description: String representing the SMS authentication message. The Message must contain the `{####}` placeholder, which will be replaced with the code.

smsConfiguration.description: Configuration block for Short Message Service (SMS) settings. Detailed below. These settings apply to SMS user verification and SMS Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). SMS MFA is activated only when `mfa_configuration` is set to `ON` or `OPTIONAL` along with this block. Due to Cognito API restrictions, the SMS configuration cannot be removed without recreating the Cognito User Pool. For user data safety, this resource will ignore the removal of this configuration by disabling drift detection. To force resource recreation after this configuration has been applied, see the `taint` command.

smsVerificationMessage.description: String representing the SMS verification message. Conflicts with `verification_message_template` configuration block `sms_message` argument.

softwareTokenMfaConfiguration.description: Configuration block for software token Mult-Factor Authentication (MFA) settings. Effective only when `mfa_configuration` is `ON` or `OPTIONAL`. Detailed below.

tags.description: Map of tags to assign to the User Pool. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

userAttributeUpdateSettings.description: Configuration block for user attribute update settings. Detailed below.

userPoolAddOns.description: Configuration block for user pool add-ons to enable user pool advanced security mode features. Detailed below.

userPoolTier.description: The user pool [feature plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-sign-in-feature-plans.html), or tier. Valid values: `LITE`, `ESSENTIALS`, `PLUS`.

usernameAttributes.description: Whether email addresses or phone numbers can be specified as usernames when a user signs up. Conflicts with `alias_attributes`.

usernameConfiguration.description: Configuration block for username configuration. Detailed below.

verificationMessageTemplate.description: Configuration block for verification message templates. Detailed below.

webAuthnConfiguration.description: Configuration block for web authn configuration. Detailed below.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolPasswordPolicy.description: Password policy for the user pool. Anvil defaults satisfy CIS Benchmarks and SOC 2 baseline.

minLength.description: Minimum password length. Default: 12. Minimum allowed: 6.

requireLowercase.description: Require at least one lowercase letter. Default: true.

requireNumbers.description: Require at least one number. Default: true.

requireSymbols.description: Require at least one symbol. Default: true.

requireUppercase.description: Require at least one uppercase letter. Default: true.

temporaryPasswordValidityDays.description: Number of days a temporary password is valid. Default: 7.

accessTokenValidity.description: Access token validity in hours. Default: 1.

idTokenValidity.description: ID token validity in hours. Default: 1.

refreshTokenValidity.description: Refresh token validity in days. Default: 30.

enum.description: Users sign in with their email address.
Users sign in with their phone number.

anvil:aws:CognitoUserPoolWaf.description: Attaches a WAF to the user pool.

arn.description: ARN of a regional-scope WebACL in the same region as the pool. Pass waf.arn from an Anvil Waf with scope "regional".
